title: MCP
teaser: One standard plug for AI and your tools

basics.say: Remember tools? Connecting an AI app to each service used to need its own custom connector. A lot of work, all different.
MCP – the Model Context Protocol – is a shared standard for those connections. Think of it as USB-C for AI.
A service like Drive, a calendar or a CRM can offer an 'MCP server'. Any AI app that speaks MCP can plug into it.
Build the connector once, use it with many AI assistants. That's why so many tools now come with MCP support.
For you, it means the AI can read from and act in the tools you already use – if you allow it.

deeper.say: MCP is an open standard, first published by Anthropic in late 2024 and now supported across many AI products.
An MCP server can offer tools to call, data to read and ready-made prompts. The AI app is the client that connects to it.
Connecting a server gives the AI real access to your data. Only use servers from trusted sources, approved by your company.
MCP connects the tools, skills bring the know-how, agents run the loop. Together, that's how modern assistants get work done.

takeaway: MCP is a shared standard that plugs AI into tools and data.
